snippet.title: Google Just Made a Fitbit With a Replaceable Battery
snippet.description:
Google just launched the Fitbit Edge - and surprisingly, its battery is actually replaceable. 

It sits between the screenless Fitbit Air and the full Pixel Watch, with an AMOLED display, GPS, ECG, up to 7 days of battery life and a bunch of interchangeable bands.
